bead.title: Document object-log S3 runtime contract and MinIO proof boundary
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Deployment docs still describe object-log S3 settings as reserved/conditional and must be updated once the runtime, Helm, and kind proof exist so readers know the exact production boundary without mistaking MinIO proof for provider-specific cloud S3 certification.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/deployment/container-runtime-contract.md:70` through `docs/deployment/container-runtime-contract.md:99` labels object-log settings as Helm-required reserved contract rather than service-consumed runtime behavior; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md:153` through `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md:157` says MinIO proof is usable only when runtime support lands and warns not to claim S3-compatible readiness if unsupported.

PROPOSED FIX: Update `docs/deployment/**` and `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md` with the exact object-log/S3 environment variables, Helm values, secret names/keys, SQLite projection storage expectations, MinIO kind proof steps, verification commands, and explicit boundary that this proves S3-compatible MinIO readiness only, not cloud-provider-specific IAM/TLS/certification.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: Parent bead `pqueue-3546063c`; `docs/helix/04-build/DEPLOYMENT-READINESS.md`; `docs/deployment/container-runtime-contract.md`; `docs/deployment/kind-helm-integration.md`; `docs/deployment/helm-static-validation.md`; `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-004-s3-object-log-sqlite-projection-mode.md`.

NON-SCOPE: Cloud-provider-specific IAM/TLS hardening beyond an S3-compatible MinIO proof. Replacing the existing fjord object-log abstraction or queue semantics. Code, chart, and kind harness implementation are handled by sibling beads.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestDocsObjectLogRuntimeContract: docs state every required object-log/S3 environment variable, Helm value, Secret key, segment setting, SQLite projection path/PVC expectation, and Postgres control-plane requirement for `object_log_sqlite_projection`.
2. TestDocsMinioProofBoundary: docs describe the MinIO kind proof command `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend object_log_sqlite_projection`, the restart/replay expectation, and explicitly avoid claiming cloud-provider-specific S3 certification.
3. TestDocsVerificationCommandsPreserved: docs preserve verification requirements for `cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog -- --nocapture`, `cargo test -p pqueue-service --test container_runtime_contract_tests -- --nocapture`, `bash scripts/ci/helm-gate.sh`, and `bash scripts/ci/kind-helm-test.sh --backend object_log_sqlite_projection`.
4. TestQualityGates: `go test ./...` and `lefthook run pre-commit` pass from the repository root after docs edits.
